info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Credit Application Management API
info.description: The Credit Application Management API provides a streamlined solution for managing credit applications within the banking environment. This API allows businesses to initiate and submit applications for credit, enabling efficient processing and evaluation. Typical consumers include banking institutions and financial service providers that seek to automate their credit application processes, reduce manual efforts, and enhance customer experience. By integrating this API, users can ensure timely and accurate credit assessments, ultimately fostering better financial decision-making.
